@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: It was a c______e that Rachael bumped into her childhood friend on the street the other day.
= coincidence
~詞義 coincidence（n.）巧合
~原文 It was a coincidence that Rachael bumped into her childhood friend on the street the other day.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Teresa doesn't have any s______gs, though she has always wanted to have a brother.
= siblings
~詞義 sibling（n.）兄弟姊妹
~原文 Teresa doesn't have any siblings, though she has always wanted to have a brother.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: John presented many v______d arguments, which is why he won the debate.
= valid
~詞義 valid（adj.）令人信服的
~原文 John presented many valid arguments, which is why he won the debate.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The family d______ted on the upcoming trip for several days, considering the cost, schedule and weather before deciding.
= deliberated
~詞義 debate（v.）深思熟慮
~原文 The family deliberated on the upcoming trip for several days, considering the cost, schedule and weather before deciding.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The mayor made a pl______e to provide free lunches in elementary and junior high schools for the next four years.
= pledge
~詞義 pledge（n.）承諾
~原文 The mayor made a pledge to provide free lunches in elementary and junior high schools for the next four years.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: To stop global warming, we have to reduce the ______ of greenhouse gasses, such as CO2.
A: implication
B: collector
C: emission
D: threshold
= C
~詞義 emission（n.）排放
~原文 To stop global warming, we have to reduce the emission of greenhouse gasses, such as CO2.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The teacher offered us bonus points as a(n) ______ to put more effort into the class.
A: agony
B: democrat
C: incentive
D: variable
= C
~詞義 incentive（n.）獎勵
~原文 The teacher offered us bonus points as a(n) incentive to put more effort into the class.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Tina took her key to the locksmith and had him ______ another one.
A: blush
B: forge
C: poke
D: shrug
= B
~詞義 forge（v.）鍛造
~原文 Tina took her key to the locksmith and had him forge another one.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The small kingdom fought in ______ with a powerful neighboring country, hoping the partnership would bring peace and security.
A: alliance
B: denial
C: illusion
D: siege
= A
~詞義 alliance（n.）結盟
~原文 The small kingdom fought in alliance with a powerful neighboring country, hoping the partnership would bring peace and security.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Jason just published his first book, and it was a ______ in his life.
A: banner
B: milestone
C: porch
D: shuttle
= B
~詞義 milestone（n.）里程碑
~原文 Jason just published his first book, and it was a milestone in his life.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: alien
B: thesis
C: collective
D: miniature
E: exploited
F: shivered

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: Billy ______ in the cold wind. He hadn't worn a jacket today.
= F
~詞義 shiver（v.）顫抖
~原文 Billy shivered in the cold wind. He hadn't worn a jacket today.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: We live in a small apartment which can't accommodate a large Christmas tree, so we got a(n) ______ one instead.
= D
~詞義 miniature（adj.）微型的
~原文 We live in a small apartment which can't accommodate a large Christmas tree, so we got a(n) miniature one instead.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: The woman thinks that she is being ______ by her boss. She has to work long hours, but her pay is really low.
= E
~詞義 exploit（v.）剝削
~原文 The woman thinks that she is being exploited by her boss. She has to work long hours, but her pay is really low.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: For Halloween, Danny dressed up as a(n) ______ from outer space.
= A
~詞義 alien（n.）外星人
~原文 For Halloween, Danny dressed up as a(n) alien from outer space.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: Fiona has completed all her credits in college. Now, she only has to finish her ______, and then she can graduate.
= B
~詞義 thesis（n.）論文
~原文 Fiona has completed all her credits in college. Now, she only has to finish her thesis, and then she can graduate.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: migration
B: beware
C: coherent
D: collaboration
E: upgraded
F: shoved

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: My laptop runs much faster now because I just ______ its operating system.
= E
~詞義 upgrade（v.）升級
~原文 My laptop runs much faster now because I just upgraded its operating system.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: Mr. Lee is a highly persuasive speaker. He always makes his points ______ and convincing.
= C
~詞義 coherent（adj.）有條理的
~原文 Mr. Lee is a highly persuasive speaker. He always makes his points coherent and convincing.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: You should ______ of leaving your personal information on unknown websites because you may become a target of scammers.
= B
~詞義 beware（v.）注意
~原文 You should beware of leaving your personal information on unknown websites because you may become a target of scammers.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: As soon as the bell rang, Dick quickly ______ his books into his backpack and left school right away.
= F
~詞義 shove（v.）亂塞
~原文 As soon as the bell rang, Dick quickly shoved his books into his backpack and left school right away.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: These birds can be seen here only from April to June. This is one of the stops on their ______ route.
= A
~詞義 migration（n.）遷徙
~原文 These birds can be seen here only from April to June. This is one of the stops on their migration route.
